description: First-time input MMIO UART with a real serial frame engine: APB4 slave, one level interrupt source and a two-wire external pin pair whose frame timing is declared.

resets.release: RTL asserts reset asynchronously on negedge rst_ni; release must satisfy clk_i recovery/removal timing.

interrupts.hold: irq_o stays high while IRQ_STATUS[0] (a received byte) or IRQ_STATUS[1] (a framing error) is set and CTRL[2] enables the interrupt.
interrupts.clear: Write 1 to the corresponding IRQ_STATUS bit (offset 0x10); reading RXDATA clears only the receive-valid cause.

prerequisites.reason: enable UART receiver before peer frame

semantics: Register map, frame timing and sampling points were read from examples/soc_generation/rtl/novauart_link.sv.

The frame format (start bit at the complement of IDLE_LEVEL, SERIAL_WIDTH data bits least significant bit first, STOP_BITS stop bits at IDLE_LEVEL, BAUD_DIV clk_i cycles per bit) is the same contract src/myfuzz/protocols/rtl/soc_uart_peer.sv implements, so the peer model can be attached to link.pins only when the request declares exactly these parameter values.
verified: Physical ports and widths come from verilator elaboration of the pinned novauart_link.sv.
The declared parameters SERIAL_WIDTH, BAUD_DIV, STOP_BITS and IDLE_LEVEL are the elaboration parameters, so the instance the composition renders is the instance that was bound.
unknown: Parity, fractional baud rates, FIFOs, flow control, glitch filtering and the electrical properties of the line are not modelled and are not claimed.
